resolution: Located and read the exact prior design in memory/project_mission_block_authoring.md, its full originating request req_2742, the original session response, and the related storyline/asset-cook notes. Recovered the intended contract: Markdown files containing declarative <npc>/<mission>/other typed blocks are the canonical human source; prose between blocks remains designer notes; stable <ref> plus @[ref] links survive renames; hand editing, the visual editor, and generation are three writers of the same round-trippable format; compile resolves refs and appends engine data into the closed runtime schema. Identified that this materially simplifies and supersedes the earlier suggestion of a database-first World Knowledge source—the wiki should be a visual projection/editor of the block files, with JSON/RLE/gamefile data derived from them.
